FP64_limitation: Reference uses identical original FP32 parameter values converted to float64, actual GAT scatter kernels and full graph. It diagnoses arithmetic; does not certify exact real arithmetic or update gradients.
interpretation: Native-vs-native and family-vs-family repeated deltas quantify forward variation; fixed-input native fused bias vs separate+private bias isolates boundary rounding. Repeated FP64 full trajectories and per-boundary FP64 references separate reduced rounding from persistent method mismatch. Every original tolerance violation is reported, not suppressed.
